subject: Bruno, an adult anthropomorphic avocado with textured green skin, swept dark hair, thick brows and a dark shirt, seated behind the steering wheel.
composition: One vertical 9:16 medium interior frame from the passenger side. Show face, forearms, both hands and horn pad, leaving clearance for the right hand trajectory.
